newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Maxtel rises on Zimbabwe payphone talks.
newsitem.headline: Maxtel rises on Zimbabwe payphone talks.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Maxtel Ltd surged on Friday on news that the firm's moves to enter into a joint venture and create a cellular payphone network in Zimbabwe were still on track, dealers said.
By 0850 GMT Maxtel was up 42.86 percent or 21 cents at 70 cents, making it the second highest percentage gainer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE). Some 89,800 shares had changed hands.
"It looks like they are going to get the contract in Zimbabwe...," one JSE dealer said.

Maxtel said on May 13, that it had reached agreement in principle in February with Cosmos Cellular (Pvt) Ltd to set up a joint venture cellular payphone network in Zimbabwe and that the details of this deal were still being finalised.
It said Cosmos was the leading cellular service provider to the sole GSM cellular network in Zimbabwe, Net One.
